meaning_en: unlawfully entering a building
quote: there is no sign of breaking or entering
quote_cn: 没有任何非法闯入的痕迹
example: He was charged with breaking and entering a school.
example_cn: 他被控闯入一所学校。
note: 刑事罪名（重罪）。动词 break in / break into。

meaning_en: a crime committed by someone with access
meaning_cn: 内鬼干的；有权限的人作案
quote: We're talking inside job?
quote_cn: 你是说内鬼干的？
example: The data breach was almost certainly an inside job.
example_cn: 这次数据泄露几乎肯定是内部人干的。
note: 职场也用：the departure was an inside job＝离职是内斗的结果。

meaning_en: deliberately ambiguous or contradictory statements
quote: But that sounds like double-talk.
quote_cn: 但这听起来就是含糊其辞。
example: His answer was classic double-talk — technically true, practically useless.
example_cn: 他那回答是典型的两面话——字面成立，实际没用。
note: 政治/公关高频。＝ weasel words（含糊其辞的措辞）。

meaning_en: to stop hedging and tell them the truth
meaning_cn: 跟某人说实话；别兜圈子
quote: You have to level with us.
quote_cn: 你得跟我们说实话。
example: Leadership needs to level with staff about the delays.
example_cn: 管理层必须就延期一事对员工坦诚。
note: ＝ be honest with someone。副词 on the level＝坦率。

meaning_en: a trained dog that detects drugs
quote: what I'd like to see in this school? Drug-sniffing dogs.
quote_cn: 我在这个学校想看到什么？缉毒犬。
example: A drug-sniffing dog flagged the luggage at customs.
example_cn: 一只缉毒犬在海关查出了那件行李。
note: sniff＝嗅；K-9 是警犬的委婉说法。

meaning_en: the body that runs all the public schools in an area
quote: Our district has strict policies
quote_cn: 我们学区有严格的规定
example: The district raised the average class size again.
example_cn: 学区又扩大了平均班额。
note: 美国教育体系核心概念。district 校区／区议会／区经理。

meaning_en: a worker who maintains outdoor areas
quote: They arrested one of their groundskeepers with drugs.
quote_cn: 他们把一个场地管理员因为毒品抓了。
example: A retired groundskeeper now handles the grounds full time.
example_cn: 一个退休的场地维护工现在全职管这块地。
note: 美式用 groundskeeper，英式常叫 caretaker／groundskeeper。

meaning_en: to be under the influence of a drug
quote: over half of the students were high on LSD
quote_cn: 一半以上的学生都处在 LSD 的药效里
example: Most of the class was high on something at lunchtime.
example_cn: 中午班上大半人都飘着。
note: 职场黑话：high on caffeine＝咖啡因上头；high on confidence＝自信爆棚。

meaning_en: time off work because of illness
quote: White is currently on medical leave.
quote_cn: White 先生目前在休病假。
example: She's been on medical leave since March.
example_cn: 她从三月起就在休病假。
note: 职场正式说法。＝ sick leave（英式更常用）。

meaning_en: the glass and equipment used in a laboratory
quote: The inventory list for the missing labware
quote_cn: 失踪实验器材的清单如下
example: All the labware has to be logged out before you leave.
example_cn: 所有实验器材离开前都要登记。
note: 不可数。细分：glassware 玻璃器皿／hardware 器材。

meaning_en: a glass vessel for separating immiscible liquids
quote: some sep funnels
quote_cn: 几个分液漏斗
example: Separate the layers with a separatory funnel, not by pouring.
example_cn: 用分液漏斗分层，别直接倒。
note: 字幕省略成 sep funnels。同类 round-bottom flask 圆底烧瓶。

meaning_en: to focus attention on one target
quote: We're zeroing in.
quote_cn: 我们正在锁定目标。
example: The auditors zeroed in on the year-end entries.
example_cn: 审计把注意力集中到了年末分录上。
note: 职场/侦探通用。＝ focus on、home in on。

meaning_en: only if you have arranged a time in advance
quote: It's by appointment only.
quote_cn: 本处仅限预约。
example: The clinic is by appointment only, no walk-ins.
example_cn: 诊所仅限预约，不接受直接来诊。
note: 服务业高频。walk-in＝免预约的客人。

meaning_en: ready to fight or compete fiercely
quote: Acting like you were all out for blood.
quote_cn: 一副要跟你拼命的架势。
example: Both teams came out all out for blood from the first whistle.
example_cn: 两队从开场哨响就是拼命的架势。
note: ＝ go all out。名词 all-out effort。

meaning_en: to stop behaving foolishly
quote: You are alive, so obviously you wised up.
quote_cn: 你还活着，显然是想明白了。
example: They didn't wise up until the second audit.
example_cn: 直到第二次审计他们才学乖。
note: get wise to／wise someone up。否定 wise up＝学聪明点。

meaning_en: to reach a mutual informal agreement
quote: We came to an understanding.
quote_cn: 我们达成了共识。
example: The two sides came to an understanding without a formal contract.
example_cn: 双方没签正式合同就达成了共识。
note: 正式度低于 reach an agreement。＝ come to terms（更常用于谈判）。

meaning_en: to increase in size or volume
quote: We'll just scale up our operation.
quote_cn: 我们把生意规模扩大就是了。
example: They scaled up hiring before validating the product.
example_cn: 产品还没验证他们就扩大了招聘。
note: 职场核心词。反义 scale down。scale up production／scale up a team。

meaning_en: a courier who buys small legal quantities and resells
meaning_cn: 「小蓝」——按小剂量代购处方药再转卖的人
quote: to meet up with my smurfs
quote_cn: 去跟我的「小蓝」们接头
example: They moved the supply chain onto a network of smurfs.
example_cn: 他们把供应链改成了靠一群「小蓝」运转。
note: 源自漫画《蓝精灵》。合规等义＝ 分包（subcontracting）。

meaning_en: the single point that limits the whole process
quote: that's the bottleneck in your brilliant business plan
quote_cn: 这就是你那份天才商业计划里的瓶颈。
example: Approvals are the bottleneck in our release process.
example_cn: 审批是我们发布流程的瓶颈。
note: 职场高频。bottleneck＝瓶颈；去掉＝ unbottleneck。

meaning_en: a party held before a baby is born
quote: The baby shower's next week.
quote_cn: 迎婴派对在下周。
example: Her baby shower is on the Saturday.
example_cn: 她的迎婴派对在周六。
note: 美式习俗：产前办 shower，产后办 sip-and-see。

meaning_en: to walk with a short, wide, unsteady gait
quote: waddling to the bathroom every five minutes
quote_cn: 每五分钟就歪歪扭扭地跑去趟厕所
example: The duck waddled across the yard.
example_cn: 那只鸭子摇摇摆摆地穿过院子。
note: 名词 waddle。鸭子的标准步态动词。

meaning_en: a drug that prevents vomiting
quote: we've got the anti-emetics tuned right
quote_cn: 说明止吐药我们已经调好了
example: The anti-emetics handle the nausea but not the fatigue.
example_cn: 止吐药管恶心，但管不了疲劳。
note: 前缀 anti- ＝ 抗／反。emesis＝呕吐（医学拉丁）。

meaning_en: a scan that shows how the body is using energy
meaning_cn: PET 正电子发射断层扫描
quote: we look at a new PET scan
quote_cn: 我们再做一次 PET 扫描看看
example: The new PET scan showed no signs of spread.
example_cn: 新的 PET 扫描没有显示扩散迹象。
note: PET＝positron emission tomography。与 MRI、CT 并列的影像检查。

meaning_en: treating the whole person, not just symptoms
quote: You know, holistic.
quote_cn: 就是那种「整体疗法」。
example: A holistic view of wellbeing covers sleep, diet and workload.
example_cn: 整体的健康观涵盖睡眠、饮食和工作量。
note: holistic health／holistic approach。holism＝整体论。

meaning_en: the power to produce a desired effect
quote: I can't speak to its efficacy.
quote_cn: 疗效我不能置评。
example: The trial showed no measurable efficacy.
example_cn: 试验没有显示出可测量的疗效。
note: 医学/药物标准词。adj. efficacious＝有效的。近义 effectiveness。

meaning_en: acceptable to me
quote: is fine by me
quote_cn: 我这边没意见。
example: Friday at four? That's fine by me.
example_cn: 周五四点？我没问题。
note: 职场确认句。＝ OK by me。

meaning_en: to set realistic expectations in advance
quote: it's also important that we manage our expectations
quote_cn: 另外，管理好我们的预期也很重要。
example: Set expectations before the kickoff, not after.
example_cn: 预期要在启动前设定好，而不是事后。
note: 职场/商务高频。under／lower expectations＝调低预期。

meaning_en: to carry out dealings
quote: So where do you transact your business?
quote_cn: 那你都在哪儿做交易？
example: All legal business must be transacted through the registered agent.
example_cn: 所有正式业务都必须通过注册代理人办理。
note: 正式书面语，≈ do business。更常见 transact with。

meaning_en: to inform or explain clearly
quote: Enlighten me.
quote_cn: 你给我讲讲。
example: Could you enlighten me on how the split works?
example_cn: 拆分是怎么算的，能给我讲明白吗？
note: 形容词 enlightening＝有启发性的（会议反馈常用）。

meaning_en: a deal is completed at a certain place
quote: Half the deals I've ever done went down at Taco Cabeza.
quote_cn: 我做过的一半交易都是在 Taco Cabeza 谈成的。
example: The biggest financing in our history went down over lunch.
example_cn: 我们历史上最大的一笔融资是在一顿午饭时谈成的。
note: go down ＝ 完成、谈成（deal／contract）。

meaning_en: to beat them up
quote: I'm sorry that I had to tune you up.
quote_cn: 抱歉我把你揍了。
example: Two guys tuned him up outside the club.
example_cn: 两个家伙在俱乐部外面把他揍了。
note: 粗俗俚语。tune＝揍、收拾。

word: You gotta give it to get it
phonetic: /juː ˌɡɑːtə ˈɡɪv ɪt tə ˈɡet ɪt/
meaning_en: nothing comes without effort
quote: You gotta give it to get it.
quote_cn: 想拿东西就得先给。
example: Networking is slow, but you gotta give it to get it.
example_cn: 人脉见效慢，但你得先付出。
note: 谚语式。职场版：you have to invest to get returns。

meaning_en: someone with real standing and influence
quote: I thought you was a player.
quote_cn: 我还以为你是个有分量的人。
example: She proved to be a player in the industry within a year.
example_cn: 一年之内她就证明了自己是这行里的狠角色。
note: 职场有褒义（能人）和贬义（玩权术的人）两读，看语境。

meaning_en: money put in to make a return
quote: Consider it a capital investment.
quote_cn: 就当是前期投资吧。
example: Treat the training as a capital investment in the team.
example_cn: 把培训当成对团队的投资。
note: 职场常用。注意 capex（资本支出）／opex（运营支出）。

meaning_en: to be difficult to obtain
quote: they're hard to come by
quote_cn: 这种很难弄到
example: Senior engineers with that background are hard to come by.
example_cn: 有那种背景的高级工程师很难招到。
note: 反义 widely available。＝ rare and difficult to obtain。

meaning_en: exclude me; I am not taking part
quote: Count me out.
quote_cn: 算我一个……算了，我退出。
example: Count me out of that meeting — nothing there concerns me.
example_cn: 那个会就别叫我了，跟我无关。
note: 反义 count me in（算我一个）。

word: the first day of the rest of your life
phonetic: /ðə ˈfɜːrst deɪ əv ðə ˈrest əv jʊr laɪf/
meaning_en: a dramatic way to mark a turning point
quote: Today is the first day of the rest of your life.
quote_cn: 今天是你余生的第一天。
example: Quitting corporate law was the first day of the rest of her life.
example_cn: 辞掉公司律师的工作是她余生的第一天。
note: 戒烟/戒酒宣传的经典口号。也作 best day of your life。

meaning_en: a unit of gemstone weight
quote: several carats' worth of zircons
quote_cn: 值好几个克拉的锆石
example: The setting is 24-carat gold, but the stones are cubic zirconia.
example_cn: 托是 24K 金的，但石头是立方氧化锆。
note: 1 carat＝0.2 克。british 金衡 24 ct＝纯金。

meaning_en: something tempting but not allowed
quote: sometimes forbidden fruit tastes the sweetest
quote_cn: 有时候禁果尝起来最甜
example: The parking spot was forbidden fruit for the whole department.
example_cn: 那个车位对全部门来说都是只能干看的禁果。
note: 源自《圣经》伊甸园。注意别和 Adam's apple 搞混。

meaning_en: where we decide the boundary is acceptable
quote: How we draw that line.
quote_cn: 我们怎么划这条线。
example: That's a policy decision — it determines how we draw that line.
example_cn: 这是政策决定——它决定我们这条线划在哪儿。
note: 职场谈合规/边界时很有用。draw the line at／on。

meaning_en: based on whim, not on a reason
quote: I'm just saying it's arbitrary.
quote_cn: 我只是说这很随意。
example: The distinction between the two tiers feels arbitrary.
example_cn: 两个等级之间的划分感觉毫无道理。
note: ＝ random。arbitrarily 副词。critique 常用。

meaning_en: a jail holding area
quote: you ought to visit lockup
quote_cn: 你真该去拘留所看看
example: He spent eighteen months in lockup before trial.
example_cn: 审判前他在拘留所待了十八个月。
note: jail＝看守所；prison ＝监狱（判决后）。也可作动词＝锁起来。

meaning_en: to stop behaving foolishly
quote: they came to their senses on that one
quote_cn: 在这个问题上他们总算清醒了
example: The market came to its senses after two years of froth.
example_cn: 市场在两年泡沫后终于清醒了。
note: 反义 in one's senses＝神志清醒。

meaning_en: to be certain to do it
quote: She's bound to find out.
quote_cn: 她肯定会发现的。
example: If you leave the file open, someone is bound to ask.
example_cn: 文件开着，总会有人来问的。
note: be bound to 也可指「受制于」（bound by a contract）。

meaning_en: it has some merit after all
quote: maybe there is something to it
quote_cn: 也许还是有点道理的
example: I was sceptical, but there's something to his argument.
example_cn: 我本来不信，但他的论证有点东西。
note: 半信半疑的说法。反义 there's nothing to it。

meaning_en: a small enclosed structure for a ritual steam bath
meaning_cn: 汗屋（仪式用的蒸汗小屋）
quote: They do this Navajo sweat lodge up by Farmington.
quote_cn: 他们在 Farmington 那边办这种纳瓦霍汗屋仪式。
example: The sweat lodge ceremony runs from dawn to midnight.
example_cn: 汗屋仪式从清晨一直持续到午夜。
note: 北美原住民传统。in the same boat 之类习语的来源地之一。

meaning_en: to encounter a problem
quote: that's where I ran into some trouble
quote_cn: 我就是在那儿遇到了麻烦
example: Most vendors run into trouble at the customs step.
example_cn: 多数供应商都是在清关这一步出问题。
note: trouble 不可数。run into＝偶遇/碰上（人）。

meaning_en: under very strict control
quote: They got it locked down tight.
quote_cn: 他们把那东西管得死紧。
example: Finance locked down tight on travel spend in March.
example_cn: 财务部三月起把差旅开支管得很死。
note: 职场描述管控。lock down＝封锁／管制。

meaning_en: to steal it
quote: I did find some pros who will rip it off for us.
quote_cn: 我确实找到了几个能帮我们把它偷出来的行家。
example: They ripped off the warehouse inventory over a weekend.
example_cn: 他们一个周末就把仓库库存偷走了。
note: rip off 也有「宰客／骗钱」（rip someone off）。

meaning_en: a thick bundle of banknotes
quote: I already spent almost the whole wad.
quote_cn: 我已经花掉差不多整叠了。
example: He paid the deposit in cash, a thick wad of it.
example_cn: 他用现金付的定金，厚厚一叠。
note: 俚语。a wad of bills／money。

meaning_en: an alloy that burns at extreme heat to cut metal
quote: So what's this stuff called again? Thermite.
quote_cn: 这玩意儿叫什么来着？铝热剂。
example: They cut the gate with a thermite charge.
example_cn: 他们用铝热剂烧开了那道门。
note: 铝＋金属氧化物的混合物，反应温度可达约 2500°C，焊轨/破门用。写作 thermite 或 thermit。

meaning_en: to be able to do it
quote: capable of firing a 7-ton shell
quote_cn: 有能力发射七吨重的炮弹
example: The team is capable of shipping this in two weeks.
example_cn: 团队有能力两周内交付。
note: ＝ be able to（更正式）。inability 反义。

meaning_en: to bring a criminal prosecution against someone
quote: I intend to press charges.
quote_cn: 我打算报警。
example: The retailer pressed charges once the serial number came back.
example_cn: 序列号查回来之后商家就报了警。
note: press charges against someone。drop charges＝撤诉。

meaning_en: no evidence whatsoever
quote: without a shred, without a modicum of evidence
quote_cn: 没有一丝一毫、一点点的证据
example: There's not a shred of evidence the deal was above board.
example_cn: 没有任何证据表明这笔交易是干净的。
note: a shred＝一丝（不可数）。shred of doubt／a shred of hope。

meaning_en: a small amount of
quote: without a shred, without a modicum of evidence
quote_cn: 没有一丝、一点点的证据
example: Show a modicum of discipline and the rest follows.
example_cn: 拿出一点自律，其他的自然跟上。
note: 正式词，多用于否定。＝ a degree of、a certain amount of。

meaning_en: to hold someone against their will
quote: illegally detained an innocent pregnant woman
quote_cn: 非法拘留了一个无辜的孕妇
example: They detained him for questioning but released him in an hour.
example_cn: 他们把他留下来问话，一小时后就放了。
note: detainer＝拘留令。＝ hold up。职场礼貌用法：detained＝耽搁。

meaning_en: to be kept against your will
quote: I feel I'm being held hostage.
quote_cn: 我觉得自己像是被扣押了。
example: Junior staff feel held hostage by the approval process.
example_cn: 基层员工觉得被审批流程困住了。
note: 字面为人质；引申为被流程/强势方拿捏。

meaning_en: to begin childbirth
quote: I'm going into labor.
quote_cn: 我要生了。
example: Her water broke at 34 weeks and she went into labor early.
example_cn: 她 34 周就破水早产了。
note: 英式 labour，美式 labor。in labor＝正在分娩。
